newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Buy new Ford, shorten in lire.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Buy new Ford, shorten in lire.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest trade ideas featured Eurodollars and Eurolire.
Sanwa said Ford's new five-year Eurodollar deal, at 48 b.p. over, offered value by comparison to a November 2000 Italy deal given they are rated almost on a par.

San Paolo said while Italian assets generally have performed well due to the lack of signs of budget trouble, the approach of the budget could put pressure on BTPs and lead to yield curve steepening. Thus Sanwa preferred the short to the long end.
** Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters**
STRATEGY The new Ford deal at a 48 basis points spread
compares well to a four-year bond by the same borrower which is currently trading at a spread of around 38 b.p. over the five-year Treasury.

Italy is trading at a spread of 23.5 b.p. With the Ford spread of 48 b.p. a trade out of Italy into the corporate should result in a yield pick-up of between 24.5 to 25.5 b.p. for similar credit. Italy is rated Aa3 by Moody's, while Ford is A1.
STRATEGY Italy's long bond is trading at 66 b.p. over

the February 2023 U.S. Treasury. There are rumors Sweden may be upgraded and Italy is further through this process. With monetary union and a good budget this should lead to a better credit rating for Italy.
STRATEGY Over the last month this bond has
underperformed others in the same area by around 40 b.p. in price terms. BLFA is cheap at 16 b.p. through the swap and at 23 b.p. through the offer side of the BTP.
STRATEGY Over the past month this bond has
underperformed area by approximately 35-45 b.p. in price terms. This bond is cheap against the swap and the BTP. It offers good liquidity and is trading close to par.
STRATEGY The above bonds are all trading cheaply at
only 5 to 6 b.p. throught the swap and all offer good liquidity.
